info.title: Payrail API
info.description: Non-custodial stablecoin payout API for Arc. Payrail quotes and plans swaps and batch payouts from multiple liquidity sources and returns UNSIGNED transactions; it never holds or signs with private keys. All amounts are bigint in base units, serialized as decimal strings (USDC/EURC=6 decimals, cirBTC=8, WETH=18; gas/fees in native USDC at 18 decimals).
